# RentaVillaCuracao

> Vacation villa rental company in Jan Thiel, Curacao. Offers private-pool villas, local hostess support, car rental help, island tips, partner tours, and real estate/property management services.

## Primary Site

- [Homepage](./): Main villa rental page with villa overview, availability calendar, car rental options, FAQ, reviews, and contact details.
- [Villa huren Curacao](./villa-huren-curacao/): Main Dutch SEO landing page for renting a villa on Curacao, focused on Jan Thiel, private pools, local hostess support, pricing, and villa selection.
- [Villa met privezwembad Curacao](./villa-met-privezwembad-curacao/): SEO landing page focused on vacation villas with private pools on Curacao.
- [Villa Availability](./#villas): Interactive villa list/map and booking request flow.
- [Discover Curacao](./#discover): Hostess tips, local partner tours, and curated island recommendations.
- [Car Rental](./#car-rental): Rental cars available through the hostess.
- [Contact](./#contact): Email, WhatsApp, and location details.

## Villas

- [Casa Dushi Dolores](./villas/casa-dushi-dolores/): Private-pool villa on Marbella Estate, Jan Thiel.
- [Casa Prikichi](./villas/casa-prikichi/): Private-pool villa with separate studio option on Marbella Estate, Jan Thiel.
- [Villa Dushi](./villas/villa-dushi/): Private-pool villa with large palapa on Marbella Estate, Jan Thiel.
- [Villa Dushi Bida](./villas/villa-dushi-bida/): Elevated private-pool villa with outdoor bar on Marbella Estate, Jan Thiel.
- [Villa Abdo](./villas/villa-abdo/): Private-pool villa with shaded porch on Marbella Estate, Jan Thiel.
- [Kas Granjero](./villas/kas-granjero/): Private-pool villa with children's pool and salt-pan views on Marbella Estate, Jan Thiel.
- [Veranosol](./villas/veranosol/): Modern private-pool villa near Jan Thiel Bay and Seaquarium Beach.

## Discover Content

- [Discover Curacao](./#discover): Homepage section with beaches, snorkeling, Willemstad, nature, outdoor activities, hostess tips, and local recommendations.
- Partner tour and island-tip pages can be added later if the site needs separate SEO pages for activities, boat tours, beaches, or restaurants.

## Booking And Availability

- Availability is read from local iCalendar files in `./calendars/`.
- Reserved dates are shown in red in the villa calendar.
- Booking requests are not instant confirmations; guests send a request and the hostess replies personally.
- Current price indication: from EUR 145 per night for 1-4 guests, plus extra guest fees, final cleaning, tourist tax, and deposit where applicable.

## Preferred Summary

RentaVillaCuracao rents private-pool vacation villas in Jan Thiel, Curacao, with personal local hostess support. The site is useful for travelers looking for villa availability, family-friendly private stays, car rental help, island recommendations, and local tour partners.
